approval_source.statement_english_translation: I approve, as an additional v2 definition, retaining integer coordinates (j_v,ell_v,n_v,u_e) as separate counting states, preserving phase labels at ell_v=0 and aperture indices at epsilon=1, and letting TR change occupations only while keeping all other coordinates fixed.
approval_source.signature_scope: Recorded operator instruction, not a cryptographic signature or historical source attribution.

authorized.counting_states: Distinct integer coordinate tuples are distinct states, even when their displayed s or psi values coincide.
authorized.zero_occupation: Retain n_v in Z_K when ell_v=0.
authorized.TR: Change occupations only; keep phases, aperture indices and link coordinates fixed.
authorized.prospective_use: Prepare and separately verify a new v2 revision; preserve PAH-001-v1 and the earlier partial draft.

prior_A_approval.rule: This additional decision supplies the state/transfer choice excluded by the earlier A-only approval; it does not rewrite that earlier record.

not_authorized: Retroactive evidence that v1 already specified these counting multiplicities.
A new functional, per-root rate, mobility exponent, physical time or limit order.
Automatic reuse of R-479 or any earlier finite/conditional PASS as proof of this v2 revision.
R-557 or PAH-OMC-030 convergence admission, or any physical promotion.
